layman_headline: All three positions are profitable — let winners ride toward targets, don't chase new entries.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had its best week since 2023, with Bitcoin surging past $77,000 and pulling everything up. Our three open trades — Ethereum, Hyperliquid, and Solana — are all green, up 4-6% each. The problem is that after such a massive rally, every candidate for a new trade looks overextended. Chasing coins that are already up 30-80% in a week is how you get caught holding the bag when the inevitable pullback comes.
layman_action: Hold all three current positions and let them approach their profit targets. Do not open any new trades right now. If ETH reaches $2,520 or HYPE reaches $83, consider taking profits. Watch for any pullbacks early next week as weekend liquidity thins out — that could create better entry opportunities.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates show negative composite scores due to extended 7-day moves (21-81%), elevated Fear & Greed at 72 (Greed), and high BTC dominance at 59.3% suppressing alt outperformance. ENA is up 81% in 7 days with RSI still at 44, suggesting data lag or manipulation — not a reliable entry. PUMP has RSI at 75, clearly overbought. The gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG) offer only 5% weekly moves with no swing trade catalyst. Our existing positions are all performing well within their trade plans. CoinDesk flags 'thinner weekend liquidity' risk for BTC at $80K test, which could create a pullback across the board — a better entry point for new positions early next week.
risk_factors: Weekend liquidity thinning could trigger a sharp pullback across all positions after this massive rally week
BTC dominance at 59.3% means alts may underperform if Bitcoin stalls at $80K resistance
Fear & Greed jumped from 45.7 weekly avg to 72 in one day — rapid sentiment shifts often precede reversals
watch_list: BTC price action around $80,000 resistance over the weekend — a rejection could pull all alts down
ETH approaching $2,520 exit target — prepare to take profits if reached
HYPE approaching $83 exit target with only 1.3% below ATH — watch for resistance and potential profit-taking
market_context: Bitcoin just posted its best week since 2023, breaking $77K with massive volume. The market is in 'Greed' territory at 72, up sharply from a weekly average of 45.7, creating a high-conviction rally but elevated reversal risk heading into thin weekend liquidity.
context_banner: All three open positions are profitable in a surging market — discipline means holding winners to target, not chasing extended setups.
